author: pgaudet
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete some children of regulation of nucleotide/nucleoside metabolic process, see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32952

The following terms have annotations or mappings: 
GO:0006141	regulation of purine nucleobase metabolic process >> 2 annotations SGD
GO:0045984 negative regulation of pyrimidine nucleobase metabolic process  >> 1 annotation SGD
GO:1900542	regulation of purine nucleotide metabolic process >> 1 annotation UniProt, fixed
GO:1902690	positive regulation of NAD metabolic process >> 1 annotation, RGD
GO:0045982  negative regulation of purine nucleobase metabolic process  >> https://www.ebi.ac.uk/interpro/entry/InterPro/IPR010078/

Annotations are here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/16fBx-Y1W_SBx_P75oAL_UZgB2l0Pk3-tyMJrNsDyYJw/edit?gid=0#gid=0

Thanks, Pascale
